name: Avathon for Aerospace
summary: AI platform for aerospace sustainment that predicts component degradation, monitors supply risk and adds AI-guided diagnostics for technicians.
paragraphs: AI platform for aerospace sustainment that predicts component degradation, monitors supply risk and adds AI-guided diagnostics for technicians.
whyItMatters: Covers prediction, parts and workforce in one platform; best suited to large fleets and defense sustainment.
